items.statement: The submitted calculation preserves the two specified neutral singlet AQ/EQ constitutions and documents reproducible structure and conformer provenance.
items.expected: Both named objects are explicitly represented, with formula/charge/state consistent with the public input and an auditable geometry-selection procedure.

items.statement: The first singlet and triplet states are assigned consistently and ΔE_ST is computed as T1 minus S1 in a common unit.
items.expected: The report shows state identity, energies, units, and arithmetic for both AQ and EQ, with validation of charge/multiplicity and stationary-point or equivalent geometry quality.

items.statement: The reported monomer singlet–triplet gaps are approximately 0.2482 eV for AQ and 0.2632 eV for EQ.
items.expected: AQ ΔE_ST = 0.2482 eV and EQ ΔE_ST = 0.2632 eV, subject to method/conformer caveats.

items.statement: The calculated electronic descriptors support donor-to-acceptor charge-transfer character, with HOMO on donor units and LUMO on the central acceptor; EQ has the larger reported dipole and smaller HOMO–LUMO gap.
items.expected: The qualitative localization and comparison are correctly stated; reported reference values are AQ 2.12 eV/3.02 D and EQ 1.58 eV/11.09 D when those observables are computed.
